greedy_rule: choose positive internal image exponent b minimizing (abs(d+b-a),b), searching until max(12,a-d+6)
pair_minimax_rule: choose identity or swap of the first two internal ranks minimizing (max absolute new debt,sum absolute new debt,swap flag)
capped_rule: if both greedy edges hit same image exponent, retain edge minimizing (absolute new debt,input exponent)
checks: inverse steps are exact odd nonmultiples of3
roots have checked forward termination at1; therefore no positive return
each policy edge is replayed by forward Syracuse
ordinal and pair minimax output identities are compared
image congestion counted on physical integers at each depth
interpretation: binary code subtree at fixed depth; no claim of density, eta, coverage of all predecessors, or asymptotic drift
